lead: Tree select: the trigger matches [Select](/select), the popup holds a [Tree](/tree). In single mode clicking a node selects it, in multiple mode you check boxes; search and async loading are supported. For flat data without levels use Select; for two or three levels picked one level at a time use [Cascader](/cascader).
